payload.text: ISSUE:0302 (cc, after WP02a, vc 2026-10-31): the harness's GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL points at a file holding [user] useConfigOnly = true (harness.bats:105's pin with it), so an arm leaning on a guessed identity goes red on every host, as kovacs's matts@kovacs.(none) found; test_helper.bash:76's comment; the redundant -c pairs in git_project's callers go. Its run is the whole suite.
